Can you describe Santa without saying red, sleigh or presents?

Sounds easy.

It absolutely is not. 😂

Christmas Don’t Say It! is a fast and funny festive guessing game where players must describe a Christmas word without using the three forbidden words listed underneath it.

Try to get your team to guess Snowman without saying snow, carrot or melt. Explain Candy Cane without saying striped, peppermint or sweet. And good luck describing an Ugly Sweater while avoiding clothing, itchy and festive.

Perfect for office Christmas parties, family gatherings, classroom celebrations, Christmas team building and holiday game nights.

Each card also includes three words players are NOT allowed to say while giving their clues.

🎉 HOW TO PLAY
Print the game sheet and cut along the lines to create 12 individual game cards.
Divide players into two teams.

One player draws a card and tries to get their teammates to guess the main Christmas word — without saying any of the three forbidden words.

For example:

Antlers • Sleigh • Rudolph
Now explain it. 😈
Set a timer for extra pressure and award one point for each correctly guessed card.

The team with the most points wins!

Add Christmas Forbidden Words to your holiday celebrations for a lively, laughter-filled challenge that brings everyone together this festive season!

HOW TO PLAY
• Select the First Clue-Giver: Each team selects a clue-giver to describe the cards' words.
• Set the Timer: The opposing team sets a 1-minute timer.
• Draw a Card: The clue-giver draws a card from the deck and starts describing the main word without using any of the forbidden words listed on the card.
• Give Clues: The clue-giver can say anything to describe the word except for the forbidden words. No gestures or sound effects are allowed.
• Guessing: The clue-giver's team tries to guess the main word based on the clues.
• Forbidden Word Violation: If the clue-giver uses any of the forbidden words, the opposing team buzzes or calls out, and the current card is forfeited. The opposing team may also enforce a penalty (e.g., deducting points).
• Scoring: If the team guesses the word correctly within the time limit, they score a point. If the time runs out or a forbidden word is used, no points are awarded for that card.
• Pass Option: Each clue-giver is allowed one pass per turn if they feel the word is too difficult, but no points are scored for the passed card.
• End of Turn: After the timer runs out, count the number of correctly guessed words. Record the score on the score sheet. Rotate the clue-giver role to the next player in the team.
• Winning the Game: The game continues with alternating turns until each player has had a chance to be the clue-giver or until a predetermined number of rounds have been completed. The team with the highest score at the end of the game wins.
